evaluation_policy.source: Keep original-language wording separate from English meaning. Preserve explicit uncertainty; do not infer identities from mixed recording. Romanized/Devanagari mismatch must be adjudicated before mixed-language WER.
evaluation_policy.english: Compare against human meaning for omissions, invented facts, questions, negation, dates, numbers, names and uncertainty. Readability and keyword overlap cannot pass fidelity.
evaluation_policy.eligibility: Clear bilingual references required for mixed-language comparison. Other/English/no-speech cases retained in their strata, never silently relabeled. Collect more cases if mixed-language coverage is absent.
evaluation_policy.gate: English normalized WER<=10% remains provisional and separate; no application to translated English or unresolved mixed script. Critical errors reviewed separately. Three20s references cannot establish representative acceptance.
evaluation_policy.freeze: User submissions saved as new private immutable references; clarifications as separate annotations. No candidate prediction for these exact clips until initial references frozen; previous full-recording Granite processing disclosed.
